education.degree: B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering
education.institution: Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology (AUST)
notes: Undergraduate thesis on transformer-based deep learning for financial time-series prediction, later published in IJCIA.
Coursework across algorithms, machine learning, computer vision, numerical methods and software engineering.

experience.role: Lecturer, Department of Computer Science and Engineering
notes: Supervise undergraduate research groups in time-series forecasting, low-resource NLP and explainable imaging; supervised work has reached IEEE, ACM, Springer and PLOS ONE venues.
Co-Investigator on the REG-NER institutional research grant, which produced the ANCHOLIK-NER corpus.
Teach six core undergraduate courses and maintain public course repositories so students work in the open from the first semester.

experience.org: A.R.i.S.E — Articulated Research Institute for Scientific Excellence
notes: Co-founded a non-profit research institute to give early-career researchers in Bangladesh the mentorship structure their institutions do not provide; partially funded by the founders.
Lead the Financial ML Studies group, coordinating time-series and emerging-market forecasting work across members.
As Treasurer, manage grant disbursement, conference fees, infrastructure costs and budget reconciliation.
Advise on architecture, delivery and engineering practice for client web and data products, including work for international clients.

experience.org: Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology (AUST)
notes: Taught software development with MVC architecture in C#/.NET and advised final-year project groups.
Built ERP feature modules from requirements to release, including secure report generation and third-party API integration.

grants.summary: Funds the construction of a large annotated named entity corpus spanning five regional Bangla varieties, together with the baseline models and evaluation protocol.
